tuning: eval/tuning.json; 3 questions fixed before model answers
control: eval/control.json; six new questions not used for tuning
order: Q8_0 vs Q4_K_M at same chosen settings
control pair three repeats alternating order
warmup: per-profile fixed ready JSON excluded from measurements
context: full context, identical order and IDs per question, compare prepares once; hashes checked across repeat/stages; no context shortening experiment

correctness.0: incorrect, irrelevant, false refusal or API failure

completeness.0: essential parts absent or false refusal
completeness.2: all essential parts covered; justified no-data refusal = 2

rubric.grounding: manual quote-to-claim entailment separately from exact match
rubric.refusals: justified vs false relative to actual retrieved context; corpus-only retrieval miss annotated separately

selection: manual quality correctness/completeness first, then successful response latency, then memory; acceptance alone not quality
judge: same Qwen2.5 3B Q4, t0 seed0 128 tokens 32768 context auxiliary only
resources: api/ps + per-process RSS 250ms observation including start/end; no RSS+VRAM sum; utilization unavailable
timing: nonstreaming; TTFT not measured; total includes retrieval, repairs, validation, judge; errors/gates separated
labels: benchmark reads only ID and question; labels never enter generator
holdout_policy: no changes to selected configuration after control
